loop: Fission engine study: fitting comparison, game fit and adoption scope
worked: The common B2 input made the side-fission and all-ion Fighters comparable at the first tick of the turn.
Separate speed, ignition and battery traces exposed the cost of each nozzle alongside its contribution to motion.

issues.observation: Chromium failed to load the fitting bench module during one preview check.
issues.effect: The interaction check needed a preview restart and a second run.

issues.observation: The request for five fittings followed a list of four.
issues.effect: I supplied a twin-aft-fission Fighter as the fifth and disclosed that choice.
